Title: Can Eagle sight be use after playing black sunrise?

Messages.Author: lordofventrue
Messages.Body:
Can Eagle's Sight be used after playing Black Sunrise?

Name: Black Sunrise
[KMW:C, LotN:PA3, POD:DTC]
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Quietus
Only usable by a locked vampire.
[qui] Only usable during a  action against you (or a card you control). This vampire unlocks and attempts to block.
[QUI] As above, but usable during any action.
Artist: Beth Trott

Name: Eagle's Sight
[Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U, BH:PM3, LoB:PO2, Third:PTz2, KoT:U/PT3, SP:PwN2]
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Auspex
[aus] +1 intercept.
[AUS] This vampire attempts to block the current action, ignoring the normal prey, predator or target restrictions for blocking actions.
Artist: Larry MacDougall; Chris Stevens

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
In principle, yes.

But: you cannot play Black Sunrise if the vampire is not allowed to block the current action (e.g. because it is directed at someone else), because Black Sunrise would force the vampire to do something that isn't allowed.

Prince of Bonn, Germany

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Yomyael is correct.
So if your vampire is locked and you want to block an action you could not normally block (for instance, your prey is rescuing a vampire from your predator in torpor), you cannot play Black Sunrise in the first place.

But if your predator were bleeding you, you could play Black Sunrise to attempt to block, and play Eagle Sight at superior to allow you to block (redundantly, but to cycle a card).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: lordofventrue
Messages.Body: What about the Superior, which says any action?

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
The "any action" part of Black Sunrise is a bit misleading. It is intended to only override the "d action" part, not general restricitions, c.f. www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/76748-black-sunrise#88361

And because Black Sunrise would force you to block, you cannot play it if you are not allowed to block.

Prince of Bonn, Germany

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body: To be clear....the thing that prevents the Black Sunrise (beside the intended design) from being able to be used even if played at superior is the fact that it lacks the explicit text allowing you to overrule the base rule of what you are allowed to react to/block which is there in the Eagle´s Sight...the any action as mentioned only expands the inferior option without overruling the valid targets set by the base rules.

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
> lordofventrue wrote:
> The card only forces you to make the attempt! You would fail! You would be untapped!!
>
You cannot attempt what you cannot do. You can't attempt to play a card that costs 2 Pool when you have only one. You can't attempt an action costing 2 Blood when the vampire has only one. Likewise, if you don't have something that specifically allows you to ignore prey-predator or target restrictions when blocking, you may not attempt, because you simply cannot do it. Therefore you cannot play a card forcing you to block.

Prince of Bonn, Germany

So a wake (on the qui vive, wake with evening's freshness, etc) and then eagle's sight would actually work.
